questions.text: Does your chest pain or pressure radiate to your left arm, shoulder, neck, or jaw?
questions.purpose: Differentiate myocardial ischemia (ACS) from non-cardiac chest pain (GERD/Musculoskeletal).

questions.text: Does the chest pain get worse with physical exertion and feel relieved when resting?
questions.purpose: Evaluate exertional demand ischemia characteristic of Angina / ACS.

questions.text: Are you coughing up thick, yellow, green, or rust-colored sputum?
questions.purpose: Distinguish lower respiratory infection (Pneumonia) from viral upper respiratory infection or asthma.

questions.text: Are you experiencing sudden weakness or numbness on one side of your face or body?
questions.purpose: Screen for acute cerebrovascular accident (Stroke / TIA).

questions.text: Do you notice any swelling of your lips, tongue, face, or difficulty swallowing?
questions.purpose: Screen for life-threatening airway compromise in anaphylaxis.

questions.text: Does the chest pain get sharply worse when taking a deep breath in?
questions.purpose: Assess pleuritic chest pain associated with Pulmonary Embolism or Pleurisy.

questions.text: Have you noticed painful swelling or redness in one of your calves or legs?
questions.purpose: Identify deep vein thrombosis (DVT) as source of pulmonary embolism.

questions.text: Do you feel a burning sensation in your chest after meals that worsens when lying down?
Did your abdominal pain start around your belly button and move to the right lower side?
questions.purpose: Identify classic migration pattern of acute appendicitis pain.

questions.text: Do you feel a burning sensation when urinating or an constant urgent need to urinate?
questions.purpose: Detect acute lower urinary tract mucosal irritation.

questions.text: Is your pain severe and located in your flank/back, coming in intense waves radiating to your lower abdomen?
questions.purpose: Identify colicky renal flank pain characteristic of nephrolithiasis.

questions.text: Is your headache accompanied by visual disturbances (like flashing lights or zigzag patterns) or extreme sensitivity to light?
questions.purpose: Differentiate migraine with aura from tension-type headache.

questions.text: Is your abdominal pain located in the right upper side under your ribs, especially after eating fatty foods?
Does your upper stomach pain feel severe and radiate straight through to your back?
questions.purpose: Identify severe epigastric-to-back pain characteristic of acute pancreatitis.

questions.text: Do you have painful pressure around your forehead, eyes, or cheeks that worsens when bending forward?
questions.purpose: Distinguish acute rhinosinusitis from generalized viral URTI.

questions.text: Do you have a sudden severe sore throat with fever and swollen neck glands, BUT NO cough?
questions.purpose: Evaluate Centor criteria for Streptococcal pharyngitis.

questions.text: Is the red area on your skin hot to the touch, swollen, tender, and spreading in size?
questions.purpose: Identify spreading deep cutaneous cellulitis infection.

questions.text: How many days ago did your main symptoms first begin?
questions.purpose: Establish symptom onset velocity to separate hyperacute emergencies from subacute/chronic conditions.

questions.text: On a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is your discomfort right now?
questions.purpose: Quantify subjective patient pain and physiological distress.
